## Documentation Checklist

- [ ] Public API changes include `///` dartdoc comments.
- [ ] Existing API docs were updated to match behavior changes.
- [ ] README or feature docs updated when user-visible behavior changed.
- [ ] New config/flags/env vars are documented.
- [ ] PR description explains migration or rollout notes (if needed).

## Quality Checklist

- [ ] No unrelated files/formatting changes.
- [ ] No new warnings from analyzer in touched files.
- [ ] New/changed logic has test coverage or rationale if skipped.
- [ ] Backward compatibility considered for route/data contract changes.
